newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's Apator IPO priced at 20 zlotys.
newsitem.headline: Poland's Apator IPO priced at 20 zlotys.

text.p: The initial public offering of up to 800,000 shares of Poland's gauge maker Apator SA was priced at 20 zlotys per share, an official of the issue's manager Creditanstalt Securities said on Friday.
"We have set the issue price of Apator at 20 zlotys per share," Pawel Tamborski, the head of the primary market department, told a news conference.
Earlier the company set the price range at 20-25 zlotys.
Apator is also offering 600,015 existing shares, now mostly held by employees, at the same price.
The subscription for shares of the Torun-based company, which wants to seek main market Warsaw listing, is scheduled for January 27-31.

Kazimierz Piotrowski, Apator's administrative director, also present, said the company decided to price the issue at the lower end of the price range to safeguard long-term growth of its shares once they enter the bourse.
The company estimates it had a four million zloty net profit in 1996 on sales of 74 million.
It expects to reach a net profit of 6.2 million on sales of 93.8 million in 1997 and a profit of 8.1 million on sales of 105.6 million in 1998.
